R8_3_65.outcome: All four pointed C4 associator classes excluded by six exact rational separators; the two-dimension Galois reduction gives general noncategorification.
R8_3_65.limitation: The direct class-zero proof eliminates the older subgroup-dual/R1453 dependency.

R8_3_65.outcome: Nonintegral total FP dimension and integral proper fusion subcategories force any braided Morita representative to yield a braiding on the original category. The general braiding exclusions therefore exclude every braided Morita representative.
R8_3_65.limitation: This restricts braided Morita constructions; arbitrary unbraided categorification remains unresolved for the six surviving rings.

R8_3_928.limitation: All seven incoming rings pass the scalar screen. No refined cone run, model, or exclusion follows from this criterion; R1795 is separately excluded by C2 Fourier packing.
